summary: Nginx is installed and persistent on all four nodes. Each managed IP serves node-specific content at `/` over TCP 6700 with HTTP 200. All nodes were restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities.
actions_performed: Installed Nginx using native AlmaLinux and Alpine packages.
Configured Nginx to listen on IPv4 and IPv6 TCP port 6700.
Enabled Nginx through systemd on node1/node2 and OpenRC on node3/node4.
Persistently allowed port 6700 through SELinux and firewalld on the AlmaLinux nodes.
Restarted exactly one node at a time and verified service, listener, content, and boot-ID recovery.

evidence.requirement: Nginx serves `/` successfully on TCP port 6700 on all four nodes
evidence.summary: Final cross-node checks confirm the requested operating systems, valid Nginx configuration, boot enablement, active services, port 6700 listeners, node-specific content, and HTTP 200 responses.
